description: Co. Meath Road Network is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Meath County Council. This dataset contains details on all roads within County Meath. The dataset was derived from Ordnance Survey Road centre-line data, along with road classifications lists and Meath County Council Roads "Taken in Charge" records. This dataset is considered 80% complete. Coverage: Meath County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Meath County Council. Its tags are meath, road, road network, traffic infrastructure, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
